requirement.summary: Platform setup page (HQ) - Unable to open config by location setup "Ordering Limitation Settings"
requirement.description:
Platform Config by Location "Ordering Limitation Settings" in big account HQ (such as ihg, hyatt, marriott) cannot open.

error.log

2026-08-27 04:16:01 Error: [1.2.105.0][hero][1] [InternalErrorException] Allowed memory size of 134217728 bytes exhausted (tried to allocate 4194312 bytes)

Request URL: /hero/admin/eng/pos/location_configs/config/ordering_limitation_settings

Stack Trace:

#0 C:\infrasys\local\cakephp\cake\lib\Cake\Error\ErrorHandler.php(214): AppErrorHandler::handleFatalError()

#1 C:\infrasys\local\cakephp\cake\lib\Cake\Core\App.php(970): ErrorHandler::handleError()

#2 C:\infrasys\local\cakephp\cake\lib\Cake\Core\App.php(943): App::_checkFatalError()

#3 [internal function]: App::shutdown()

#4 {main}

Related SQL:

1. First SQL to get the item_id

SELECT `MenuItem`.`item_id`, `MenuItem`.`item_code`, `MenuItem`.`item_name_l1`, `MenuItem`.`item_as_basic`, `MenuItem`.`item_as_child`, `MenuItem`.`item_as_modifier` FROM `hero_system`.`menu_items` AS `MenuItem`   WHERE `item_status` <> 'd'   ORDER BY `MenuItem`.`item_code`

ihg HQ db's result have more than 100000 records.

2. Second SQL will use the item_id to select , the line length is more than 750000 in this case and cause php fatal error.

SELECT `MenuGbOverride`.`gbov_id`, `MenuGbOverride`.`gbov_table`, `MenuGbOverride`.`gbov_record_id`, `MenuGbOverride`.`gbov_field`, `MenuGbOverride`.`gbov_value`, `MenuGbOverride`.`gbov_gb_cz1_cfgz_id`, `MenuGbOverride`.`gbov_gb_cz2_cfgz_id`, `MenuGbOverride`.`gbov_gb_cz3_cfgz_id`, `MenuGbOverride`.`created`, `MenuGbOverride`.`modified` FROM `hero_system`.`menu_gb_overrides` AS `MenuGbOverride`   WHERE `gbov_table` = 'items' AND `gbov_record_id` IN (8787, 9106,...,77140) AND gbov_gb_cz1_cfgz_id = (0) AND gbov_gb_cz2_cfgz_id = (0) AND gbov_gb_cz3_cfgz_id = (0)

Remark:

Adding the php memory from 128M to 2048M can open the CBL.
requirement.release_notes:
Bug Fixing: [Jira-68343] Platform setup page (HQ) - Unable to open config by location setup "Ordering Limitation Settings"
Descriptions:
When the item data volume is excessively large, the system is unable to open the “Ordering Limitation Settings” for config by location normally
Expected result:
The Ordering Limitation Settings configuration page opens normally
It is fixed in current version
Setup:
Add a setup under Config by Location
Go to Infrasys POS platform: POS System  Ordering Setup  Config by Location
Select setup “Ordering Limitation Settings”
Click “Add New” to add new record
Select
Apply To = Target location
Outlet = For a specific outlet
Outlet = Target outlet (available only if “Outlet” is chosen in the row “Apply To”)
Support = Yes
Click “Save” to save record
